variants.name: 晶冠
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate one NEW harp-bow weapon concept using the attached screenshot ONLY as a WEAPON STRUCTURE reference, not as an edit target. Do not copy the character, costume, quiver, arrow, pose, screenshot background, green palette, or game-render quality.

Preserve the reference weapon's defining concept: a broad ornate openwork upper bow limb with a generous harp-like window, a distinct actual handgrip near the middle of the bow, a slimmer tapering lower limb, and several long taut musical strings visibly integrated across the open inner span of the weapon. The harp frame is part of the functional bow architecture, not a miniature separate lyre glued onto a normal bow. The silhouette should be asymmetric and rich with purposeful negative spaces like the attached bow.

Reinterpret it as a Heaven Burns Red (HBR)-inspired futuristic anime weapon: crisp faceted crystalline armor, refined silver-white mechanical seams and sockets, elegant sharp tips, restrained pale-blue luminous cores, delicate clean contour lines, polished cel-shaded game concept illustration. Main palette blossom pink and clear sky blue in balanced areas, with cool silver-white structural accents, small blue-gray grip; NOT green, gold, red-black, or predominantly violet.

Show only ONE entire weapon isolated on pure white, portrait 2:3 composition, upright side view with upper tip at top and lower tip at bottom, main bowstring on the right side, all tips and decorations fully visible inside margins. Resting UNDRAWN main string connects both tips in a straight line, distinct from the 5 or 6 musical strings. Musical strings must attach at both ends to visible rigid support points. Accessible wrapped handgrip center must lie at the same vertical level as the midpoint between main-string anchors, near the middle of the image; clear finger space. Each limb and string has an unambiguous connection. Do not add hands, characters, arrows, quivers, floating fragments, text, labels, watermark, or alternate states.

Variant direction: Broad upper limb built as a crystalline corolla, five angular petal openings around a sky-blue core, pink outer armor and blue inner spine. Five long pale-blue musical strings make an orderly fan across the broad upper interior toward a stepped bridge just above the centered grip. Lower limb slender and elegantly hooked. Closest variant to the reference's ornate carved architecture.
